text:
So vivid are the blushes

of your flowers, rare friend,

that to your flowers I say:

"Hearts made into flowers."


And at times I come to think:

If this tree became lips...

ah, how many kisses would be born

from so many lips of fire...!


Friend: what lovely garments

the Lord has given you;

he preferred you with his love

dressed in cloud-colors...


How good heaven has been to you,

tree of my land...

With my soul I bless you,

because you give me your poetry...


Beneath a garden of cloud-colors,

seeing you I came to believe

that the sun was already sinking

inside your branches.

translation.title: Tree of Fire
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the fire tree's flowers as hearts, lips, and sunset.
